verdict.rationale: Flagsmith's own GitHub README documents official SDKs in 15+ languages (TypeScript, .NET, Java and more) and framework integrations such as React and Next.js. The docs reference client-side and server-side SDKs, SDK use with the Edge Proxy, and OpenFeature providers, and a hands-on community evaluation confirms the Java SDK is in real use. missing for 10: dedicated per-SDK reference documentation in the pack, an explicit list of supported languages, and polished SDK quality (the hands-on report says Java SDK error reporting needs improvement).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
